experiments.name: Methodological & Sequence Homology Non-Causal Rejection Filter
experiments.hypothesis: Sentences describing experimental strain creation, cloning, transduction, and sequence homology comparisons (e.g. 'double mutant was created by transduction', 'peptides exhibit 27% amino acid sequence identity with SalK and SalR') are frequently misparsed as causal assertions, creating false positives on Dev (PMC2430206 dltA->GraRS, PMC2358977 SalK->89K). Filtering these non-causal clauses will boost direct precision without lowering recall.
experiments.implementation: Implemented METHOD_HOMOLOGY_RE filter in sentence processing and relation generation in evryn/paper/extractor.py.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Direct F1 increased by +0.0146 on Dev by pruning methodological false positives.

experiments.name: Bacterial Two-Component System (TCSTS) Syntactic Signaling Resolution
experiments.hypothesis: Bacterial signaling literature heavily features two-component regulatory systems (Sensor Kinase -> Response Regulator) introduced as '<Sensor>/<Regulator> two-component system' or '<Kinase> and its cognate regulator <Regulator>'. In Dev (PMC1974823, PMC2358977), these were either missed or reversed (FimR->FimS instead of FimS->FimR). Detecting conjoined two-component pairs and resolving kinase-to-regulator directionality will eliminate FNs and reversals.
experiments.implementation: Added TCSTS_SLASH_RE and TCSTS_AND_RE conjoined entity detection in evryn/paper/extractor.py with biochemical kinase (*S, *K, *B) to response regulator (*R, *A) coupling.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Dev Direct F1 reached 0.4894 (+58.8% relative over original baseline), Dev Cross F1 reached 0.2765 (+68.0% relative), and Dev Structural Match reached 0.2730 (+72.2% relative).
